definitions.full: H4781. Merodak מְרֹדַךְ proper name, of a divinity chief god of Babylon in Nebuchadrezzar's time (Assyrian Mar(u)duk(u) Schr COT Gloss Tiele Babylonian -Ass. Geschichte. 530 ff.
